record.question: The term for which the Court directs the offender to be imprisoned in default of payment of a fine shall
options: not exceed one-fourth of the term of imprisonment which is the maximum fixed for the offence, if the offence be punishable with imprisonment as well as fine
not exceed half of the term of imprisonment which is the maximum fixed for the offence, if the offence be punishable with imprisonment as well as fine
not exceed one-third of the term of imprisonment which is the maximum fixed for the offence, if the offence be punishable with imprisonment as well as fine
record.explanation: For imprisonment plus fine, default imprisonment may not exceed one-fourth of the maximum term.
